welcome.tagline: The shared custody calendar, clear for both parents.
welcome.previewA11y: Monday to Friday with you, handover Friday evening, weekend with the other parent

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Same account as on alternly.com: your household and swaps are already here.
login.googleHint: Signed up with Google on alternly.com? Set a password with “Forgot password”, then sign in here.

register.subtitle: Free. Works in the app and on the web.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link that’s valid for one hour.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, you’ll get a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: It replaces your old one in the app and on the web. Your other devices will be signed out.
reset.incompleteLink: Incomplete link. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.

join.askNewLink: Ask the other parent to send you a new link from their app.
join.title: Invitation
join.invite: {{inviter}} invited you to join the household {{household}} on Alternly: the custody calendar, vacations, and swaps, shared between the two of you.
join.signedOutHint: Create your free account (or sign in): you’ll join the household right after.
join.notFound: This invitation can’t be found. Check the link you received.
join.used: This invitation has already been used. If it was you, sign in to get back to the household.
join.expiredWithName: This invitation has expired. Ask {{name}} for a new one.
